description: A glass kitchen-style blender with a cloudy amber liquid sits on a dark laboratory bench. Beside it are a test tube rack holding a tube with a pale sediment, and a glass pipette. On the left, an open spiral notebook has small pencil sketches of angular, legged shapes that look like bacteriophages. A glass flask and a stand with tubing sit in the dim background. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square, with no frame or visible text.
